Vendored browser assets from lcms-wasm 1.0.5 (npm), wrapping LittleCMS 2.16.

Source: https://github.com/mattdesl/lcms-wasm
LittleCMS source: https://github.com/mm2/Little-CMS/tree/c2a5401

These self-hosted ES module and WASM assets work with static GitHub Pages subpaths. No runtime CDN or vendor ICC profile is needed. Keep both license files when updating. Download the pinned npm package and replace dist/lcms.js and dist/lcms.wasm together; run the ICC proof tests after an update.
